hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (4 GB VRAM) + ONNX Runtime DirectML

limitations.occlusion_recovery: Tracks withstand up to 30 frames (0.5s) of physical body-to-body occlusion before dropping ID.
limitations.offscreen_players: Broadcast camera excludes 6-8 players at any given frame. System explicitly tracks OFFSCREEN status without hallucinating coordinates.
limitations.identity_resolution: Requires overhead HUD marker or pre-match slot confirmation; unresolved players retain anonymous track identifiers.
